title: Top Management Brief: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals were bought locally without a specification for two years, and nothing stopped it.

items.text: A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test [FND-0001]. Its seals had been bought locally without a specification since March 2022 [FND-0003].
HFACS sorts causes into four levels: unsafe acts (L1), preconditions (L2), supervision (L3) and organisational influences (L4).

rows: Any site that buys spares locally

items.text: Purchase records show local buying with no specification check [FND-0003; EVD-0003].

items.decision: Set one enterprise rule for critical-spares specifications
items.trade_offs: Cost and lead time against consistent parts.

items.name: Sites with verified spares specifications
items.measure: % of sites whose critical-spares orders all cite a specification

items.decision: Set an enterprise standard for return-to-service hold points

items.name: Sites with signed hold points
items.measure: % of sites with a signed return-to-service hold point

items.decision: Require a named technical authority for substitutes at every site

items.name: Sites with a filled approving role
items.measure: % of sites with the role filled

items.decision: Adopt an enterprise alarm philosophy for gas detection

items.name: Sites aligned to the alarm philosophy
items.measure: % of sites with gas alarms classed by action

items.question: How will we know every site applies the spares rule?
items.why: Local buying without a specification ran for two years before this event.
items.good_evidence: Sampled audits from the auditor assurance pack
